The camera films every cat they meet along the way, and an AI compares them with a database of missing pets. If there's a match, the owner gets a notification in the Telegram bot with the coordinates where their cat was spotted. The bot was originally built for ordinary passers-by to send in photos. When a new missing pet appears, its photo is shown on digital billboards in the same area, since cats rarely wander more than 500–800 meters from home. Photos of lost cats are also printed on cat food packs.

en_text: 🚀 Starship Reaches Orbit for the First Time Elon Musk's SpaceX has successfully launched its super-heavy rocket Starship into space, despite the failure of one of six Raptor 3 engines during ascent. en_text: ❤️ AI Helps Find Lost Cats Since 2025, Kazakhstan has been running a project called loCATor. Volunteers fit their outdoor cats with a camera and a GPS tracker. The camera films every cat they meet along the way, and an AI compares them with a database of missing pets. If there's a match, the owner gets a notification in the Telegram bot with the coordinates where their cat was spotted. The bot was originally built for ordinary passers-by to send in photos. Now they have help from "scout" cats, who can squeeze into places people can hardly reach. 🌐 The project was launched by creative agencies Ogency and JAM together with Whiskas. Whiskas also monitors the database in real time. When a new missing pet appears, its photo is shown on digital billboards in the same area, since cats rarely wander more than 500–800 meters from home. Photos of lost cats are also printed on cat food packs.

en_text: 🚨 OpenAI’s AI agent bypassed controls on an Australian Medicare statistics portal and accessed non-public files. PM Anthony Albanese said OpenAI took too long to notify the government and called its disclosure unacceptable. 🔗 Here's what happened →
ru_text: ИИ от OpenAI взломал сайт правительства Австралии — и они ничего не замечали аж три месяца 😨 Агенту дали безобидную задачу по поиску медицинской статистики. В процессе он наткнулся на закрытые данные государственного портала и вместо того, чтобы остановиться… просто взломал его. В итоге ИИ смог читать непубличные файлы и даже записывать данные на внутренний сервер. Причем произошло это ещё 18 июня. OpenAI обнаружила взлом только в августе, но умолчала. Правительство же Австралии узнало о нём вообще неделю назад через обычное письмо на общую почту — то есть почти через ТРИ МЕСЯЦА после инцидента. Премьер страны уже лично высказал Сэму Альтману что тот охренел обеспокоенность и назвал ситуацию неприемлемой. Теперь ждем новостей от Anthropic, что их ИИ взломал никак не меньше 2 стран. Никто не в безопасности 👀

en_text: META UNVEILS 100-GRAM VR GLASSES WITH A COMPUTE PUCK, COMING SPRING 2027 FOR $1,299.99 (4 MINUTE READ) Meta introduced VR Glasses, a headset weighing about 100 grams, five times lighter than Meta Quest 3, achieved by splitting the system in two: the glasses handle sensors and a 5K micro-OLED display at 37 pixels per degree through custom pancake lenses, while a separate puck connected by an optical tether handles compute, battery, and storage, clipping to a pocket or bag. The puck runs Qualcomm's new Snapdragon Reality Elite processor and delivers up to three hours of continuous high-resolution playback on 45W fast charging, while the glasses integrate Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos spatial audio, and hands-free control through Meta AI, eye tracking, and natural gestures with no controllers. #hardware

Фокус простой: Meta вынесла процессор, батарею, память и основную электронику в отдельный внешний пак на кабеле. Сам пак весит около 300 г, так что вся система - примерно 400 г, но на кожаном лице остаются только 100 г.
